title: Agent teams enabled
source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/costs (agent teams are off by default; about 7x the tokens of a standard session when teammates run in plan mode)

fix.text: Agent teams use approximately 7x more tokens when teammates run in plan mode, because each teammate keeps its own context window. Keep team tasks small and self-contained, close idle teammates, or unset CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS if you do not use them.
